terra.problem: “The Collection for the Saints” describes Paul’s instructions to the Corinthians, not an event shown happening in Galatia. The passage says Paul had directed the Galatian churches about the collection, but does not explicitly say he gave them the same weekly instructions.

“A Letter to the Churches” describes Paul writing to Galatia, but the passage does not place him there when he wrote. The Galatians’ turning to a different gospel would be a more clearly Galatia-based focus.
“Crescens Goes to Galatia” names Galatia as his destination, but the passage does not describe an event happening there.
